Class ConfigurableMimeFileTypeMap

java.lang.Object
jakarta.activation.FileTypeMap
org.springframework.mail.javamail.ConfigurableMimeFileTypeMap
All Implemented Interfaces:
InitializingBean
public class ConfigurableMimeFileTypeMap extends jakarta.activation.FileTypeMap implements InitializingBean
Spring-configurable FileTypeMap implementation that will read MIME type to file extension mappings from a standard JavaMail MIME type mapping file, using a standard MimetypesFileTypeMap underneath.

映射文件应采用如下格式，由 Java 激活框架指定：

# map text/html to .htm and .html files
text/html  html htm HTML HTM
Lines starting with # are treated as comments and are ignored. All other lines are treated as mappings. Each mapping line should contain the MIME type as the first entry and then each file extension to map to that MIME type as subsequent entries. Each entry is separated by spaces or tabs.

默认情况下，使用位于本类同一包中的mime.types文件中的映射，该文件涵盖了许多常见的文件扩展名（与activation.jar中开箱即用的映射形成对比）。可以使用mappingLocation属性覆盖此设置。

可以通过 `mappings` 属性添加额外的映射，其格式遵循 `mime.types` 文件的格式。

Since:
1.2
Author:
Rob Harrop，Juergen Hoeller

    • createFileTypeMap

      protected jakarta.activation.FileTypeMap createFileTypeMap(@Nullable Resource mappingLocation, String @Nullable [] mappings) throws IOException
      Compile a FileTypeMap from the mappings in the given mapping file and the given mapping entries.

      默认实现会创建一个 Activation Framework `MimetypesFileTypeMap`，传入映射资源（如果有）的 InputStream，并编程方式注册映射行。

      Parameters:
      mappingLocation - 一个 mime.types 映射资源（可为 null）
      mappings - 一个 MIME 类型映射行的数组（可以为 null）
      Returns:
      已编译的 FileTypeMap
      Throws:
      IOException - 如果资源访问失败
      See Also:
      • MimetypesFileTypeMap(java.io.InputStream)
